title: The thermos
logline: The thermos, close, on the tailgate: dented, the cup-lid off and steaming, a crab sticker half peeled. The thing on every flats page since 2012, given its page. The flats behind it out of focus.

panels.composition: Close on a dented steel thermos on a station wagon's tailgate with its cup-lid off and steaming, a half-peeled crab sticker on it, mudflats soft beyond.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, close on a dented steel thermos on an old station wagon's tailgate with its cup-lid off and steaming and a half-peeled crab sticker on its side, tidal flats soft beyond, no words legible

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
